answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 31331 Country: India Title: Is a menstruating woman allowed to touch tajweed rule books (qaida) that have words, verses or short surahs of the Qur'an? Question: Is a menstruating woman allowed to touch tajweed rule books (qaida) that have words, verses or short surahs of the Qur'an? Answer ID: 31331 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 550/550/M=1432) She can touch it but she should not touch the exact Quranic verses. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
